notes: Ported from PixelLab object 1cd05f6c-664b-4569-9a3c-b6a70103f8c3 (style 1, 40 px canvas, 8 rotations and a v3 walk) by tools/world-art/port-pixellab.mjs: pixels unscaled, each facing seated on the class anchor by whole pixels. Snapped to the shadow, steel, mithril, water, bronze, bone, gold, torch ramps before the lock (lock.mjs snapTo): its hue is its identity. Body lifted 1 ramp step(s) for its dark floor (lock.mjs liftBody). Idle from a v3 clip on its own still (port-pixellab.mjs idle): a ping-pong from the still through two of the 8 frames, whole-pixel registered, in the colours of the still.
